mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) indicate accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >45% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint signal of declining UNRATE and rising PAYEMS produces negative 5-day returns in >55% of instances, or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% yoy) combined with stable or rising federal funds rate signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS stable/rising, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strengthening consumer demand for durable goods, correlating with higher corporate revenues and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >55% of periods when HOUST rises, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production decline exceeding 0.5% month-over-month signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in >45% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1) combined with stable federal funds rate indicates robust economic expansion without aggressive monetary tightening, supporting positive equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: strong economy with stable monetary policy
failure_condition: Joint signal of rising GDPC1 and stable FEDFUNDS produces negative 60-day returns in >55% of instances, or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Robust labor market growth (PAYEMS > 100 thousand jobs) supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days in strong labor market regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >55% of periods when PAYEMS > 100, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
